preview.overview: Notre Dame hosts Stanford with the College Football Belt on the line. The Irish are heavy favorites in this matchup, bringing dominant recent form and a commanding head-to-head advantage into their home stadium.
key_matchups: Notre Dame's offense vs Stanford's defense: The Irish have scored 49, 52, 41, 37, and 27 points in their last five games, while Stanford has allowed 57, 45, 35, and 7 points in recent contests.
Stanford's ability to stay competitive: The Cardinal have won only one of their last five games (37-27 vs Hawai'i) and face an Irish team that has not lost since claiming the belt.
preview.betting_angles: Notre Dame owns a 25-14 series advantage and has dominated recent meetings decisively, winning 56-23, 49-7, and 49-20 in their last three matchups. Stanford's sole recent win in the series came in 2022 by 16-14, but the Irish have won every contest since, suggesting a clear power gap has emerged. Stanford's recent form is concerning—the Cardinal are 1-4 in their last five games with losses of 57-3, 45-6, and 35-7.
preview.prediction_writeup: Notre Dame is the clear choice to retain the belt. The Irish have won three straight against Stanford by an average margin of more than 20 points, and their recent five-game run shows consistent dominance: wins of 52-0, 49-10, 41-13, 37-26, and 27-10. Stanford's form has deteriorated sharply, with four losses in their last five games including a 57-3 defeat to Wake Forest and a 45-6 loss to Miami. The Cardinal's lone bright spot came against Hawai'i with a 37-27 victory, but that is insufficient evidence they can compete with an Irish team riding this kind of momentum. Notre Dame should control this game from start to finish and extend their dominance in the series.
